Miranda: quick sync — following up on the lightweight trace header idea for edge inference clients. want to make sure cost attribution stays stable across retries without blowing up header size. thoughts?

Rahul: TL;DR: propose a tiny 'slim' header with deterministic bucketing done client-side. header: `x-rw-trace-slim: t=<trace_id>;b=<bucket>;v=1` where b is computed as hash(trace_id) % 256. keeps server-side work minimal. :+1:

Elena: heads-up — small header is fine, but we need to ensure the bucketization doesn't leak tenant-level info across shared infra. bucket count matters for collision rate vs privacy. :thinking:

Sam: implementation note: clients can use fnv32a(trace_id) then % N. N=256 is a good sweet spot for cost granularity vs header entropy. we should document seed/version in `v=` so we can rotate.

Miranda: on retries: if client generates new trace_id per attempt, cost bucketing will drift. do we require clients to preserve trace_id across retries?

Rahul: yes — recommend retry semantic: preserve trace_id and set new span_id for each attempt. that keeps bucketing stable and attribution consistent. if client cannot preserve, server will fallback to request-path hashing.

Elena: server-side considerations: when header present, we should treat `b` as authoritative for quick bucketing and also store it in trace metadata for later billing joins. when missing, derive bucket = hash(route + client_ip) but mark derived=true so billing can filter uncertain attributions.

Sam: example client snippet (JS):

```
// simple deterministic bucket
function slimHeader(traceId, buckets=256) {
  const h = fnv1a(traceId);
  const b = h % buckets;
  return `t=${traceId};b=${b};v=1`;
}
```

Miranda: good. ops questions: how do we handle rollouts / header version upgrades?

Rahul: plan: servers accept `v=1` and `v=2` for a grace period. internal router should map older buckets to current billing bins using a stable mapping table, then sweep after 90 days. add log-level telemetry when unknown `v` received.

Elena: analytics: ensure we emit a boolean `slim_header_source` with values [client, derived, absent] on ingestion. that lets Optimize and console show confidence bands for cost estimates.

Sam: perf: header is ~20-40 bytes, no perf hit. small change to edge proxies to copy header into internal trace envelope. we should add unit test for retry-preserve-trace semantics.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window for edge-proxy change: 2025-11-12 02:00 UTC (tentative).

Miranda: action items: Rahul -> write mini-RFC with header spec & rotation rules; Sam -> client snippets for frontend + sdk; Elena -> privacy review + analytics schema; I'll own server ingest + mapping table. check-in next wed. :calendar:
